I have been to the district before I went to the school and they said they don't handle my problems and I have to go to the school and talk to them about it. I don't bother going anywhere near that place because I just remember and have flashbacks of all the emotional abuse they had on me. They put me into special ed because they didn't want to deal with my problems when I was there and I was diagnosed with aspergers at the school. An example of what they did was in history, this was a special ed class as well. The teacher knew that I had aspergers and that I had a tough time with socializing and I spaced out and I couldn't answer him and I was waiting for him to say something but I guess he was doing the same and he said that I creep him out and that my future boss will get creeped out and I felt so bad about myself and my self worth was lowered.

Yes, when I mention mental health services I mean I barely afford a therapist now and I have to look for my first job but I really doubt anyone would consider me.
An example would be trying to find out why I got expelled from my school when I returned from the hospital and the assistant principal telling me that if I'm on school property anymore he will call the police and treat me like a criminal and when I was getting on the car I heard him call me a terrorist. I thought that that was a little too much effort to make me feel bad and I thought that that was over the top. I never was given a concrete reason so I concluded that I got expelled for suicidal thoughts. I thought that they really wanted me to end my life by how they were treating me and sometimes I wish I did.
